known.via: English Wikipedia "Graves de Vayres AOC" (redirects to "Graves de Vayres")

limits: The minor grapes together: at most 30%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation for red and white wine, about 1,700 acres in two communes inside Entre-Deux-Mers. Reds use Merlot and Cabernets, whites use Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle.
